facts: About 2.4 million people (2012), second to the port city of Douala
About 750 m above sea level, in the Centre Region
worth_knowing: It began as a German trading base for rubber and ivory, called Jaunde after the local Yaunde or Ewondo people. France chose it as capital of its mandate in 1922.
